reveal.semantics: If (flags &6)==4, return0 without modification. Else write duration f32 to+8, flags|=5, elapsed+4=0, return1.

conceal.semantics: If (flags &4)==0, return0 without modification. Else write duration f32 to+12, flags|=2, elapsed+4=0, return1.

integer.semantics: If current target at+8 equals requested target, preserve all fields. Else flags+0=0, duration+4=requested integer duration, previous+12=old target+8, target+8=requested target.
